verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a VPN and network-connectivity platform. Amending commits or undoing unpushed commits is a source-control capability, which is a category error for this kind of product. None of the evidence shows Tailscale shipping any git commit-editing functionality; mentions of SSH, coding environments, and GitHub runners concern network access only.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can amend the latest commit or undo unpushed commits to fix or split them
